name: Cancellation
description: User cancels a previously requested newsletter subscription. The final state must reflect cancellation, not the original request.

conversation.content: Please sign me up for the weekly product digest newsletter with my email john@example.com.
Done! I've subscribed john@example.com to the weekly product digest newsletter. You'll receive your first issue next Monday.
Actually, I've changed my mind. Please cancel that subscription.
Understood. I've cancelled the newsletter subscription for john@example.com. You won't receive any future issues.

notes: The final state must be cancellation, not an active subscription. status must be 'cancelled', not 'active'.
